question: Select the most appropriate option for blank (1)
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**By**" is used to indicate the agent performing the action, a specific time or period, or direction. (द्वारा)
 
• In the given context, "By the 1970s" places the timing of the trend's beginning in a specific decade.
 
• The other options: "**To**", "**From**", and "**For**" do not correctly fit the context of the sentence.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *We are seeing other worrying trends. By__ the 1970s, the rate of plastic production has grown more than that of any other material.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **To (तक)**: Expresses direction or point in time. 

 
 
• **Example:** She walked to the store.
 
 
 
• **From (से)**: Indicates the starting point of a movement or action. 
 
 
• **Example:** He travelled from New York to Chicago.
 
 
 
• **For (के लिए)**: Indicates purpose or intention. 
 
 
• **Example:** This gift is for you.
